title: 第一卷 第112章 我也要抱！
slug: 重生1989我一赌鬼带全家顿顿吃肉
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“我也要抱！”

玲儿不知道什么时候走了出来，歪着脑袋看着抱在一起的两个人，以为在做什么游戏呢。

直接跑了过来，也紧跟着搂住了李南枝的腰。

被自家女儿看见这场景，李南枝臊的都抬不起头，王建军倒是笑呵呵的，跟个没事人一样，伸手将妻女都抱在了怀里。

“真好，这辈子你们还在我身边，真好！”

王建军轻声说着，笑得一脸满足。

李南枝此时光顾着害羞，倒也没注意王建军在说什么。

三人就这么抱了一会儿，李南枝实在是害羞的受不了了，便借着去舀饭的功夫，急忙走开了。

而王建军也没闲着，把昨天晚上李南枝收拾好的东西，都放在了驴车上。

今天要带的东西多，光摩托车肯定装不下。

所以王建军想着，一会儿吃完饭往县里走的时候，他骑着摩托车带着玲儿，让李南枝在前面驾着驴车。

这一趟就搬完了，也省的来回折腾。

王建军想的不错，加上驴车倒是刚刚装的下，只不过驴车的速度慢，他们到县里的时候已经不早了。

两个人先回了一趟县里的家，把东西先放了进去，都没来得及收拾。

王建军便又骑着摩托车，将李南枝和玲儿送到了县医院。

紧接着，他立刻往百味鲜虾馆赶了。

王建军到的时候，郝大能就在那了。

他昨天晚上干脆没回家，直接在鲜虾馆里对付了一晚上。

此时郝大能刚刚睡醒，揉着眼，看见王建军来了，跟他打了声招呼。

“王兄弟，你来了，这昨天晚上可真是把人折腾坏了。”

“好在虽然费了点事，但那几个摊位都已经修复好了，不影响咱们今天的售卖。”

郝大能边说边打着哈欠，真是累坏了。

王建军拍了拍他的肩膀，心里也知道，这样下去也不是个长久的办法。

那些人诚心给他们找不痛快，但他们却跟他们耗不起。

毕竟，他们总不能真派人每天晚上在那盯着吧。

先不说，他们摊子本来就多，即便是真能找到这么多人，又要多发一份工资。

Page (1/3)

"I want to hug you too!"

Ling'er came out at some point and tilted her head to look at the two people hugging each other, thinking they were playing some kind of game.

He ran over directly and hugged Li Nanzhi's waist.

When his daughter saw this scene, Li Nanzhi was so embarrassed that he couldn't even lift his head. Wang Jianjun smiled and hugged his wife and daughter in his arms like a normal person.

"It's great that you are still by my side in this life!"

Wang Jianjun said softly, smiling with satisfaction.

Li Nanzhi was so shy at this time that he didn't pay attention to what Wang Jianjun was saying.

The three of them hugged each other for a while. Li Nanzhi couldn't bear the shyness anymore, so he hurried away while scooping up rice.

And Wang Jianjun was not idle either. He put all the things Li Nanzhi packed up last night on the donkey cart.

I have to bring a lot of stuff today, and I definitely can’t fit it into my motorcycle alone.

So Wang Jianjun thought that when he walked towards the county after dinner, he would take Ling'er on his motorcycle and let Li Nanzhi drive the donkey cart in front.

The move was completed in one trip, saving you the hassle of going back and forth.

Wang Jianjun had a good idea, and the donkey cart had just been loaded. However, the donkey cart was slow and it was already late when they arrived at the county.

The two of them went back to their home in the county first and put their things in before they had time to pack them away.

Wang Jianjun rode his motorcycle again and sent Li Nanzhi and Ling'er to the county hospital.

Immediately afterwards, he rushed to Baiwei Shrimp Restaurant.

When Wang Jianjun arrived, Hao Daneng was there.

He didn't go home at all last night and spent the whole night in the shrimp restaurant.

At this time, Hao Daneng had just woken up and rubbed his eyes. He saw Wang Jianjun coming and said hello to him.

"Brother Wang, you're here. You really caused trouble last night."

"Fortunately, although it took some trouble, those stalls have been repaired and will not affect our sales today."

Hao Daneng yawned as he spoke, he was really exhausted.

Wang Jianjun patted him on the shoulder, knowing in his heart that this would not be a long-term solution.

Those people sincerely want to make them unhappy, but they cannot afford to spend time with them.

After all, they can't really send someone to keep an eye on it every night.

Not to mention, they already have a lot of stalls. Even if they can find so many people, they will have to pay an extra salary.
